VAL-EDITOR-001.evidence: Code inspection: katla_app/src/application/mod.rs lines 338-345 detect Ctrl+S and push EditorAction::SaveScene. process_editor_actions() in editor/mod.rs lines 278-285 calls SceneManager::save_to_file(). Unit test test_ctrl_s_suppressed_when_keyboard_captured verifies keyboard capture gating.

VAL-EDITOR-002.evidence: Code inspection: show_save_confirmation() sets timer to 2.0. update_timers() decrements each frame. Status bar renders confirmation text while timer > 0. Unit test test_save_confirmation_timer_countdown verifies countdown from 2.0 to 0.0. Unit test test_save_confirmation_timer_never_negative verifies clamping.

VAL-EDITOR-003.evidence: Code inspection: Preferences panel uses PopupStyle::Modal which sets want_capture_keyboard=true. Ctrl+S is gated by !prev_want_capture_keyboard (mod.rs line 344). Unit test test_ctrl_s_suppressed_when_keyboard_captured verifies the suppression mechanism.

VAL-EDITOR-004.evidence: Code inspection: katla_app/src/application/mod.rs lines 212-215 set minimized flag when width/height is 0. Lines 445-448 skip rendering when minimized (request_redraw and return). No swapchain operations occur when minimized.

VAL-EDITOR-005.evidence: Code inspection: katla_app/src/application/mod.rs lines 199-210 clear minimized flag and recreate swapchain on resize to valid dimensions. Transient texture bindless indices updated, shadow atlas views refreshed, camera aspect ratio updated. Rendering resumes on next RedrawRequested.

VAL-EDITOR-006.evidence: Code inspection: katla_app/src/application/mod.rs lines 393-401 handle WindowEvent::Occluded. Occluded(true) sets minimized flag and skips rendering. Occluded(false) clears flag, recreates swapchain, resumes rendering.

VAL-EDITOR-014.evidence: Code inspection: TextInput widget in katla_ui sets want_capture_keyboard=true when focused. Same gating mechanism as VAL-EDITOR-003 prevents Ctrl+S. Unit test test_ctrl_s_suppressed_when_keyboard_captured covers this.

VAL-EDITOR-015.evidence: Code inspection: save_to_file() uses std::fs::write() which is a single system call. The winit event loop is single-threaded, so rapid Ctrl+S presses are fully serialized — each save completes before the next starts. No interleaving or truncation is possible. The assertion requires valid scene files with no corruption, which is guaranteed by single-threaded serialization.
